review.observation: Full original: pale spotted smooth skin, broad continuous tail fin, frilled external gills and short limbs. The branched gills stay painted; no external mammalian-style pinnae are present. Eye and gill proportions, toes and ground contacts remain separate anatomy/authoring holds.

decisions.paintingObservation: No paired projecting mammalian pinnae are depicted. External gills, ear openings and all other actual head/neck paint remain present and are not excluded.
